name: Linguistic Circuit — Gemma-2-2B
description: A circuit discovered across 31 linguistic prompts spanning antonyms, synonyms, irregular plurals, irregular past tenses, and derivational morphology in Gemma-2-2B. 527 recurring features were identified with a 30% co-occurrence threshold (min 10 of 31 graphs). The circuit is dominated by layer-0 embedding features detecting lexical/structural patterns, mid-layer (3-7) transcoder features mapping to domain knowledge, and late-layer (8+) features performing token selection. Notably, the most-appearing features relate to code, technical, and scientific text patterns — suggesting Gemma-2-2B's linguistic circuit strongly leverages representational overlap with technical document structures found in its training data. The highest avg_influence feature (layer 0, feature 11637899) fires on 'part + preposition' constructions, consistent with the template structure of all prompts. Feature 8 (layer 8, feature 3234687) — 'words and phrases related to the meaning of words' — is the most interpretively relevant to linguistic reasoning tasks.
